chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Sama'ah, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), said:

I asked him about a man who performed the Tawaf of Hajj and the Tawaf al-Nisa before performing Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwa. So he said: 'It does not harm him; he performs Tawaf between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and he is free from his Hajj.'

key_terms.فَرَغَ مِنْ حَجِّهِ: Free from his Hajj (completed the obligations)

ai.seo_question: Is it valid to perform Tawaf al-Nisa before Sa'i in Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that performing Tawaf al-Nisa before Sa'i does not invalidate the Hajj, reflecting the Shia view that the order of rituals is recommended but not strictly obligatory for validity. This ruling underscores the flexibility in Hajj mechanics, allowing pilgrims to fulfill their core obligations even if performed out of the ideal sequence, thereby ensuring the completeness of their pilgrimage.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), said, ‘

I asked himasws about a man who performed Tawaaf, being Tawaaf of the Hajj, and Tawaaf Al-Nisaa before he performed Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa. So heasws said: ‘It would not harm him. He should, perform Tawaaf between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and he would be free from his Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from Sama‘ah who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs Tawaf of al-Hajj and Tawaf of al-Nisa’ before Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful. He must perform Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and his Hajj is complete.’”
